parameters.command:
STATE_DIR="/volume1/ALLDATA/.n8n_scan_state"
mkdir -p "$STATE_DIR"
LAST_CHECK="$STATE_DIR/last_scan_check"
SKIP_LOG="$STATE_DIR/scan_skip_log"
TIMER_LOG="$STATE_DIR/scan_timer_log"
PROCESSED="$STATE_DIR/scan_processed"

touch "$LAST_CHECK" "$SKIP_LOG" "$TIMER_LOG"
> "$PROCESSED"

# Daha önce zaman aşımına düşmüş ama sonra Metrics oluşmuş klasörleri tekrar yakala
while IFS= read -r SENTRIX; do
  [ -z "$SENTRIX" ] && continue
  FOLDER="/volume1/ALLDATA/Scans/${SENTRIX}/"
  [ ! -d "$FOLDER" ] && continue

  METRICS=$(find "$FOLDER" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name 'Metrics*.txt' | grep -v old | head -1)
  if [ -n "$METRICS" ]; then
    sed -i "/^${SENTRIX}$/d" "$SKIP_LOG"
    sed -i "/^${SENTRIX} /d" "$TIMER_LOG"
    echo "$SENTRIX" >> "$PROCESSED"
    echo "{\"kind\":\"candidate\",\"path\":\"$METRICS\"}"
  fi
done < "$SKIP_LOG"

# Yeni klasörleri tara
for FOLDER in /volume1/ALLDATA/Scans/*/; do
  [ ! -d "$FOLDER" ] && continue
  SENTRIX=$(basename "$FOLDER" | tr -d ' ')
  [[ "$SENTRIX" == *diag* ]] && continue

  grep -q "^$SENTRIX$" "$PROCESSED" && continue

  METRICS=$(find "$FOLDER" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name 'Metrics*.txt' | grep -v old | head -1)
  CFG="$FOLDER/Effective.cfg"
  QC="$FOLDER/${SENTRIX}_qc.txt"
  SDF="$FOLDER/${SENTRIX}.sdf"

  if [ -z "$METRICS" ]; then
    FIRST_SEEN=$(grep "^${SENTRIX} " "$TIMER_LOG" | awk '{print $2}')
    if [ -z "$FIRST_SEEN" ]; then
      echo "$SENTRIX $(date +%s)" >> "$TIMER_LOG"
    else
      NOW=$(date +%s)
      ELAPSED=$((NOW - FIRST_SEEN))
      if [ "$ELAPSED" -gt 1800 ]; then
        if ! grep -q "^$SENTRIX$" "$SKIP_LOG"; then
          echo "{\"kind\":\"alert\",\"reason\":\"Metrics.txt bulunamadı (30 dk)\",\"sentrix_id\":\"$SENTRIX\"}"
          echo "$SENTRIX" >> "$SKIP_LOG"
        fi
        sed -i "/^${SENTRIX} /d" "$TIMER_LOG"
      fi
    fi
    continue
  fi

  if [ ! -f "$CFG" ]; then
    if ! grep -q "^$SENTRIX$" "$SKIP_LOG"; then
      echo "{\"kind\":\"alert\",\"reason\":\"Effective.cfg bulunamadı\",\"sentrix_id\":\"$SENTRIX\"}"
      echo "$SENTRIX" >> "$SKIP_LOG"
    fi
    continue
  fi

  if [ ! -f "$QC" ] && [ ! -f "$SDF" ]; then
    if ! grep -q "^$SENTRIX$" "$SKIP_LOG"; then
      echo "{\"kind\":\"alert\",\"reason\":\"qc.txt ve sdf bulunamadı\",\"sentrix_id\":\"$SENTRIX\"}"
      echo "$SENTRIX" >> "$SKIP_LOG"
    fi
    continue
  fi

  # Son kontrolden sonra değişmiş Metrics dosyaları
  if [ "$METRICS" -nt "$LAST_CHECK" ]; then
    echo "{\"kind\":\"candidate\",\"path\":\"$METRICS\"}"
  fi
done

touch "$LAST_CHECK"
